dedupe_keys.name: system operator of the ups of russia report on the operation of russia s power system in 2024 operational data

description: This is a five-page report by the System Operator of the Unified Power System of Russia summarising how the Russian power system worked in 2024, based on operational data. It states generation of 1,180.7 billion kWh and consumption of 1,174.1 billion kWh in the Unified Power System, up 3.1% on 2023 (2.7% under comparable temperature conditions), with consumption for each interconnected system (Centre, Middle Volga, Urals, North-West, South, Siberia, East) and the isolated systems. It gives the annual peak demand of 168,273 MW on 15 January 2024, a table of regional and interconnected-system records that exceeded their earlier historical maxima, and installed capacity of 263,717 MW on 1 January 2025 with the changes from new equipment, re-rating and decommissioning. Access: free PDF download from the system operator's disclosure pages; the text is in Russian and no licence is stated. Coverage is national, split by interconnected system and region. Caveats: it is a short summary with figures for one year, not a data series or machine-readable table, and later sections of other years' reports must be fetched separately. It suits capacity planning and power system operation studies, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
